proxyUrl.label: Proxy URL
proxyUrl.help: Optional. URL Headroom proxy (example: http://127.0.0.1:8787 or https://headroom.example.com). Configured URLs probe-gated before provider routing. Auto-start opt-in only works local addresses.

proxyPort.label: Proxy Port
proxyPort.help: Default port used for auto-detect/auto-start when proxyUrl is not set (default: 8787).

pythonPath.label: Python Path
pythonPath.help: Optional explicit python executable for python fallback launcher (for example: python, python3, py, or full path).

retryMaxAttempts.label: Retry Max Attempts
retryMaxAttempts.help: Optional maximum number of upstream retry attempts for connection/read/5xx failures when the plugin auto-starts a local Headroom proxy. Lower values fail faster for interactive chat.

connectTimeoutSeconds.label: Connect Timeout Seconds
connectTimeoutSeconds.help: Optional upstream connection timeout for the auto-started local Headroom proxy. Lower values surface network failures sooner.

requestTimeoutMs.label: Compression Request Timeout
requestTimeoutMs.help: Maximum milliseconds to wait for one compression request before returning the original messages.

circuitBreakerThreshold.label: Circuit Breaker Threshold
circuitBreakerThreshold.help: Consecutive compression failures before temporarily bypassing Headroom.

circuitBreakerCooldownMs.label: Circuit Breaker Cooldown
circuitBreakerCooldownMs.help: Milliseconds to bypass compression after the circuit breaker opens.

routeCodexViaProxy.label: Route OpenAI Codex Via Headroom
routeCodexViaProxy.help: When enabled, OpenClaw will use the active Headroom proxy as the in-memory upstream base URL for the built-in openai-codex provider so provider traffic flows through Headroom.

gatewayProviderIds.label: Gateway Provider IDs
gatewayProviderIds.help: Optional list of OpenClaw provider ids to route through the active Headroom proxy in memory. Friendly aliases codex, claude, copilot, and gemini are also accepted. When set, this overrides the default openai-codex-only routing.

providerUpstreams.label: Provider Upstream Overrides
providerUpstreams.help: Optional map from OpenClaw provider id to absolute upstream URL. When the headroom plugin rewrites a provider's base URL, it also injects an x-headroom-base-url header so the proxy can forward to the listed upstream (for OpenAI-compatible providers such as OpenRouter or opencode-go whose URLs are not /v1-rooted). URLs must NOT include a trailing /v1 — the proxy appends the request path itself. Requires HEADROOM_UPSTREAM_ALLOWED_HOSTS on the proxy to whitelist the upstream host.

providerSessionHeaders.label: Provider Session Headers
providerSessionHeaders.help: Optional map from OpenClaw provider id to a header name. The headroom plugin generates a per-process UUID and injects it under that header on requests to the provider, so OpenAI-compatible third-party APIs that route via a server-side session/accounting layer (e.g. opencode-go's x-opencode-session) can identify the session without the caller having to thread a session id through every chat-completions call.

persistentCompaction.label: Persistent Compaction Mode
persistentCompaction.help: How /compact and overflow recovery rewrite the SQLite transcript. "openclaw" (default): OpenClaw native compaction only — matches upstream delegation (ownsCompaction=false). "hybrid": Headroom replace pre-pass, then OpenClaw LLM compaction. "headroom": algorithmic durable compaction via Headroom /v1/compress (zero LLM). Per-turn assemble() always uses Headroom.

transcriptHygiene.label: Transcript Hygiene
transcriptHygiene.help: Turn-end in-place Headroom replace on tool-heavy messages (no truncate). Enabled by default in hybrid mode. Object form: { enabled, softThresholdTokens, debounceMs }.

transcriptProjectionWaitMs.label: Transcript Projection Wait
transcriptProjectionWaitMs.help: Milliseconds to wait for OpenClaw SQLite transcript projection to settle after hygiene rewrites. Set 0 to disable. Default: 120000.

durableCompaction.label: Durable Compaction (deprecated)
durableCompaction.help: Deprecated alias for persistentCompaction. true = headroom, false = openclaw.

assembleCompressConfig.label: Assemble Compress Config
assembleCompressConfig.help: Optional /v1/compress config for per-turn assemble() compression. Default includes protect_recent: 2 so recent tool turns are preserved. Passed to the Headroom proxy via the headroom-ai SDK.

assembleSkipBudgetRatio.label: Assemble Skip Budget Ratio
assembleSkipBudgetRatio.help: assemble() skips proxy compression while the history's rough token estimate is below tokenBudget × this ratio. Default 0.7 so compression runs before OpenClaw's native overflow compaction (which triggers near budget − reserve − system prompt) on ~200k windows, while 100–200k sessions in 1M windows are left untouched. Range (0, 1].

assembleReserveTokens.label: Assemble Reserve Tokens
assembleReserveTokens.help: Tokens subtracted from tokenBudget before the skip ratio is applied. OpenClaw passes the full model window as tokenBudget but its prompt also carries the system prompt, tool schemas and a compaction reserve (≥ 20000). Set to roughly reserve + system prompt tokens so compression starts before native overflow compaction. Default 20000.

protectToolResults.label: Protect Tool Results
protectToolResults.help: Tool names (or * globs) whose results are restored verbatim after every /v1/compress round trip (assemble and durable compaction). Deferred tool_call wrappers are resolved to the real tool first, so an MCP tool can be named as analyze_video, <server>__analyze_video or mcp__<server>__analyze_video. The resolved name is also what the proxy sees, so its own --protect-tool-results list can match MCP tools. Default: none.

skipAssembleWhenGatewayRouted.label: Skip Assemble When Gateway Routed
skipAssembleWhenGatewayRouted.help: When true and gatewayProviderIds is non-empty, skip assemble() compression because live provider traffic already passes through the Headroom proxy (avoids double compression). Default: false.
